name: Secure Containers (Rootless Docker, RHEL)
description: Runs a dedicated rootless Docker daemon inside the dev container without mounting a host engine socket or enabling privileged mode.

version.description: Select a Docker Engine and CLI version, or use latest. Docker 29 or newer is required.

moby.description: Install Moby instead of Docker. Moby RPMs are not available for UBI 10, so true is unsupported.

mobyBuildxVersion.description: Install a specific Docker Buildx version, or use latest.

dockerDashComposeVersion.description: Install the Docker Compose CLI plugin, or disable it with none.

installDockerBuildx.description: Install the Docker Buildx CLI plugin.

installDockerComposeSwitch.description: Install a docker-compose compatibility wrapper that invokes the Docker Compose plugin.

username.description: Non-root user that owns the rootless daemon. A dedicated securecontainers user is created when the remote user is root.
